name: Kokushikan Honoka
source:
"This must be destiny. His death and our meeting!"

Head of the Ministry of Education, which is in charge of education and information. Nicknamed the “Conjurer of Words” for her ability to manipulate information and confuse the public. Many things about her, including her true face, are shrouded in mystery. She's typically quiet, but there are rumors about her ambition to become the next Founder...

[From [url=https://shuten-kyodan.com/en/character/]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]For her "romance game", she dons the disguises of [url=/c153059]Mii[/url], [url=/c153060]Kikka[/url], [url=/c153058]Yua[/url], [url=/c156454]Shikka[/url], and the entirety of the "Shuten Academy" student body.[/spoiler]
